{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
data['biomarker_final'] = data['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Define response as 'responded' (1 = responded, 0 = did not respond)
# Compute response rate by sex
response_by_sex = data.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Compute the difference in response rates between females and males
response_diff = response_by_sex['F'] - response_by_sex['M']

# Print results
response_by_sex, response_diff"}
